Welcome back, Dienane! How was the trip to Belem?
It was great! I went on Tuesday. I took an early flight, at six.
Six! Did you have breakfast at the airport?
Yes, I had a coffee there, and I met Ana from Finance.
Nice. And the conference?
Very good. I saw a presentation about new employees. I have many ideas now!
I went to Belem last year, and I loved the Ver-o-Peso market. I bought a lot of fruit there!
Oh, I saw the market too, but only from the bus.
I met a coworker from Finance.

Hello, everyone. My name is Pedro, and I am a speaker at this conference. I came from Manaus yesterday. I took a very early flight, at five in the morning, so I got up at three! At the airport I had a coffee and I met an old friend. The flight was short and quiet. In the afternoon I went to the hotel and I made my presentation for today. Thank you for coming!

Hi, Dienane, it is Carla. I had a great weekend! On Saturday, I went to the beach on the Xingu River with my family. We took the boat at nine o'clock. We saw beautiful birds, and my children made a big sand castle. At lunch, we had fish and rice. We came home at six, very tired but happy. And you? What did you do? Tell me on Monday!

Last month, Dienane went to Belem for an HR conference. She took a flight from Altamira in the morning. At the airport, she had a coffee and met a coworker. At the conference, she saw a great presentation about new employees. In the evening, she came back to the hotel very happy.
